name: Cursor 3
description: A unified workspace for building software with AI agents. Features multi-repository layouts, seamless handoff between local and cloud agents, and an agent-first interface that lets developers work at a higher abstraction level while maintaining access to IDE features. Represents the biggest architectural change since Cursor launched, codenamed 'Glass'.

name: Viktor
description: An AI coworker that lives in Slack/Teams, connects to 3,000+ tools, and can proactively automate tasks. It observes team workflows and suggests automations without being prompted. Reported to have hit $1M ARR in just 3 hours after launch.
